title: Filipino-Style Chicken Dumplings
description: A unique fusion dish of Filipino and Indian flavors, featuring tender dumplings in a savory sauce.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the yeast, 1/4 cup warm water, and 1 tablespoon olive oil. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the tender chicken to the bowl and mix well.
Add the Filipino-style dumpling wrappers to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a round dumpling.
Pan-fry the dumplings in olive oil until golden brown.
For the sauce, combine the soy sauce, fish sauce, ginger, and garlic in a saucepan.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve the dumplings with the sauce on top and garnish with chopped green onions.
